name: Rectangular Pontoon
description: Synthetic rectangular pontoon for teaching. Table range: 1–5 m; linear interpolation between 0.25 m samples. No real vessel data. Operational loading starts with lightship and empty synthetic ballast tanks; deck cargo is placed in the planner.

resources.label: Sealed rectangular training hull — signed KN cross curves
resources.description: Offline polygon-clipping reference: watertight rectangular 100 × 20 × 8 m prism, constant immersed volume; no deck openings or downflooding. Angles -90 to +90 degrees; volumes 2000 to 10000 m³.

resources.label: Assumed training roll parameters
resources.description: Synthetic teaching assumptions: effective radius 7 m and damping ratio 0.05. These are not measured hull properties and are not recalculated when weights change.

resources.label: Small-trim equilibrium
resources.description: Synthetic teaching model. Linear trim limited to 1 degree; both perpendicular drafts must remain within the upright table range.

resources.label: Rectangular pontoon display geometry
resources.description: Explicit rectangular hull: length LBP from AP to FP, full beam about centreline, baseline to moulded depth. Display geometry only; calculations use their declared resources.

draftLimit.label: Design draught teaching reference
draftLimit.source: Synthetic pontoon principal dimensions: designDraft = 3 m; training hydrostatic table
draftLimit.applicability: Teaching reference at design draught, not a certified maximum loading limit.
